headline: Steady near highs, limited upside left
chart_note: 52-week range up to $281.07 high. Currently $266.20, near the top of its range and above its 200-day average.
why_today: Johnson & Johnson continues trading near its 52-week high, supported by steady pharma and medtech performance. It's a low-drama, dividend-paying holding rather than a momentum story right now.
pro_1: 23 analysts rate it Buy, and the stock is trading above its 200-day moving average - a stable uptrend
pro_2: Pays a reliable 1.99% dividend, appealing for income-focused portfolios
con_1: Average price target of $275.64 implies only about 4% upside - most of the good news may be priced in
con_2: PE of 30.8x is rich for a mature healthcare conglomerate with mid-single-digit growth
